events.title: Greetings from the Brazil-Argentina border, where waterfalls are flowing at near-record rates
events.description: The Iguazú Falls span more than a mile across both countries. A rain-soaked October, which scientists link to the Super El Niño, has sent near-record volumes of water surging over the towering cliffs.

events.title: Trump eases Canada tariffs ahead of US midterms
events.description: The move comes as Trump's Republican Party scrambles to maintain control of the US Congress, with a Republican candidate in a key Senate race saying she had lobbied to lift the tariffs on Canadian products.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Trump eases Canada tariffs ahead of US midterms

events.title: Afghan women could lose one of their last paths to a higher education
events.description: The US has defunded one of the last universities giving Afghan women the chance to receive an education after the Taliban takeover in 2021. DW spoke with a student who says she's lost hope of ever earning a degree.

events.title: Japan-Russia ties erode as journalist sits in Moscow jail
events.description: Japan is demanding access to a journalist who was arrested by Russian security services. The Kremlin claims that Japan is using journalists as spies.

events.title: Greece joins countries putting age-limits on social media, banning access for kids under 15
events.description: Greece has passed legislation banning social media access for children under 15. New rules will come into effect on January 1, 2027, and are designed to protect children's mental health.

events.title: Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at Bayern Munich training
events.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany has been taken to hospital after collapsing at the club's training ground.

events.title: European leaders gather in Budapest for anniversary of Hungarian revolution as Magyar resets EU ties
events.description: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has joined other foreign guests in Budapest to mark the 70th anniversary of Hungary’s 1956 anti-Soviet uprising, signaling a new chapter in relations after the ouster of former Prime Minister Viktor Orbán

events.title: Pope Leo XIV cancels Assisi trip on doctors' advice as he recovers from surgery
events.description: Pope Leo XIV will not travel to Assisi on Tuesday for a major interfaith peace gathering because he is continuing to recover from thoracic surgery he underwent last week, the Vatican said Friday

events.title: Soil mapping aims to boost agricultural production in Kenya
events.description: A new Kenyan initiative is helping farmers better understand their soils in a bid to improve crop yields amid intensifying climate shocks.

events.title: ‘Burden and loss’ builds in DR Congo, as Kenya strengthens Ebola containment
events.description: As Ebola continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), more resources are needed to fight the disease and feed patients and families, UN agencies said on Friday.

events.title: Tyler Robinson hearing ends without trial date set, prompting fiery plea from Erika Kirk's lawyer
events.description: Tyler Robinson's Utah trial for the assassination of Charlie Kirk still has no start date as prosecutors and defense attorneys clash over timing.

events.title: Trump says judge is 'desecrating' Charlie Kirk's memory amid fight over assassination trial date
events.description: Trump slammed the Utah judge in the Charlie Kirk assassination case, saying the trial should take a month, not years, as a 2029 date was proposed by the defense.

events.title: Emmy-winning TV producer charged with stalking ex-wife, longtime news anchor, days after divorce
events.description: Emmy-winning North Carolina TV producer Randall Saunders Kerr allegedly drove near a home daily despite a protective order after his divorce.
